title: Test 3: complex multi-prompt virtual-data apps
backendLabel: Virtual business tables; read-only Office 365 Users profile
design: Five model/effort configurations once each, four identical ordered authoring prompts in each fresh app: build, connect the existing app to Office 365 Users, extend workflows, then change requirements. Independent external review.

controls.profileGate: Build the app first; connect Office 365 Users through the existing app in stage 2, not a general Cowork connector. Pause remaining runs at a shared unresolved authorization or managed-app connector blocker.
controls.storageRule: Synthetic related virtual/local tables; browser-local persistence is accepted. No managed-server persistence requirement.
controls.stopRule: Unresolved common platform/authorization blocker; two defect repairs; thirty observed active-generation minutes per authoring response or ninety per task. No hidden replacement or extra app.
controls.privacyRule: Read only the current user's profile through Office 365 Users. No real approvals, transactions, other employee reads, directory writes, admin settings, publication or sharing. Keep profile evidence private.
controls.comparisonRule: Compare within this four-stage complex-app scope only. Preserve Test 1/Test 2 as completed separate cohorts. Selected Cowork settings do not prove internal builder routing.

stages.title: Build the relational virtual-data app first
Connect the existing managed app to Office 365 Users
Virtual approvals, asset lifecycle, themes and preferences
Approval policy change, revisions, cost centres and responsive refinement
